newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Sales of 13,900 MT were 78 percent below the previous week and three-quarters under the 4-week average. The major buyer was Mexico (13,800 MT).
Sales of 16,300 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were all for Japan.
Exports of 51,700 MT were 34 percent above the prior week and the 4-week average. Mexico (30,600 MT), Israel (13,000 MT), and Japan (8,100 MT) were the destinations.
